spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ककते)
1 To be proud.
3 To be unsteady.
4 To be thirsty.
(इ) ककि (कंकते)
To go.

r. 1st cl. (कक्कति)
To laugh.

m. (-कः)
1 A crow.
2 A plant, (Ardisia solanacea?)
3 A lame man, a cripple, one whose legs are wanting or useless.
4 One of the divisions of the world or

Dvīpas.
5

A measure.
6 Washing the head, bathing by dipping the head only into the water.
7 A sectarial mark, the Tilaka?
8 Shameless, arrogant.
n. (-कं)
1 Modus coeundi.
2 A multitude or assemblage of crows.
f. (-का)
An appellation of several plants, as,
1 The common Bakapuṣpa: see वक.
2 Kakjhangi, (Leea hirta); also in this sense काकी;
3 A medicinal plant, vulg. Kākoli;
4 The Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius);
5 Opposite leaved fig tree: see उडुम्बर;
6 A potherb, (Solanum Indicum, &c.) see काकमाची.
E.
कै to sound, Uṇādi affix कन्; or क for कु bad, ill, and अक to go, &c.

r. 1st cl. (कक्खति)
To laugh. to laugh, at or deride: see कख.

(ए) r. 1st cl. (कक्खति)
To laugh, to laugh at, to deride.

m. (-न्दः)
Gold.
E.
कनी to shine, affix द, and the initial repeated.

m. (-लः)
A bird, the Cātaka.

m. (-त्स्थः)
A prince, the grandson of IKṢVĀKU, and ancestor of RĀMA.
E.
ककुद् an emblem of royalty, and स्थ who resides.

m. (-त्स्थः)
A name of

RĀMA.
2

The name of a sovereign, also Purañjaya.
E.
ककुट् preeminent, अण् affix, and स्थ who stays or is.

f. (-त्) or ककुद mn. (-दः-दं)
1 The hump on the shoulders of the Indian bull.
2 An ensign or symbol of royalty, as the white parasol, &c.
3 Chief, pre-eminent.
4 The peak or summit of a mountain.
E.
क happiness, कु to sound, affixes क्विप् and तुक्; त becomes द; or with a final vowel, taking an additional affix अच्.

m. (-द्मान्)
1 A bull.
2 A mountain.
f. (-द्मती)
The hip and loins.
E.
ककुद् a bull's hump, &c. affix मतुप्.

f. (-न्या)
A river.
E.
ककुद्मिन् a mountain, कन्या a daughter.

mfn. (-द्मी-द्मिनी-द्मि)
1

Peaked.
2

Humped.
m. (-द्मी)
1 A mountain.
2 A bull.
E.
ककुद, and मिनि aff.

n. (-रं)
The cavities of the loins: see कुकुन्दर.

f. (-प्)
1 Space, region or quarter, as east, west, &c.
2 Beauty, splendor.
3 Unornamented hair, or the hair hanging [] down as a tail.
4 A wreath of Champaka flowers.
5 A Rāgiṇī or personified mode of music.
6 A Śāstra or sacred treatise.
E.
क wind, स्कुभ to spread, क्विप् affix and the स is dropped; or कक to be proud, उभ् aff.

m. (-भः)
1 A tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.)
2 A part of a lute, the belly, a wooden vessel covered with leather placed under its neck to render the sound deeper, or a crooked piece of wood at the end of the lute.
3 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes.
f. (-भा)
1 Space, region, quarter: see ककुभ्.
2 One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
E.
ककुभ् space, and अच् affix; or क wind, स्कुभ spread, क affix and स rejected, &c.

f. (-नी)
A kind of perfume: see नली.

m. (-कः)
A worm in the stomach.

m. (-लः)
A perfume, a plant bearing a berry, the inner part of which is a waxy and aromatic substance.
n. (-लं)
The berry, possibly the fruit of the Cocculus Indicus.
E.
कक to be proud, with क्विप् affix, कुल to accumulate, अच् affix; also with कन् added कक्कोलक (-कः-कं.)

mn. (-लः-लं)
A poisonous substance of a black colour, or the colour of a raven, whence its name; possibly the berry of the Cocculus Indicus.
n. (-लं)
A division of the infernal regions or hell.
(-लः)
1 A raven.
2 A potter.
3 A snake.
4 A boar.
5 A drug; as follows.
f. (-ली)
The name of a vegetable substance used in medicine, described as sweet and cooling, allaying fever, removing phlegm, &c.; it is said to be a root brought from Nepal or Morung.
E.
काक to be unsteady, &c. and ओलच् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Hard, solid.
f. (-टी)
Chalk.
E.
कक्ख to deride, अटन् affix, fem. affixes टाप् and ङीष्; also खक्खट.

m. (-कः)
A plant of the fibres of which a kind of rope is made, (Corchorus olitorius, Rox.)
E.
कक्खट hard, पत्र a leaf, and कन् aff.

r. 1st cl. (कक्वति)
To laugh.

m. (-क्षः)
1 The armpit.
2 A spreading creeper, a climbing plant.
3

Grass.
4

Dry grass.
5 A wood, a forest.
6 A forest of dead trees, a dry wood.
7 A private or inner chamber or part of a house.
8

Sin.
9

A buffalo.
10 The side or flank.
11 (In astronomy,) The orbit of a planet, or the circle anciently termed a deferent.
12 A gate.
13 The beleric myrobalan, (Terminalia belerica.)
mf. (-क्षः-क्षा)
1 A wall.
2 The end of the lower garment, which after the cloth is carried round the body, is brought up behind, and tucked into the waistband.
f. (-क्षा)
1 An elephant's rope, the string round his neck, also his girth.
2 A woman's girdle or zone.
3 An enclosure, a part or division of an edifice.
4 A part of a car.
5 Objection or reply in argument.
6 Similarity, parity.
7 Emulation, rivalship.
8 The jeweller's weight, the

Ratti.
9

Painful boils in the armpit, side, shoulder, &c.
n. (-क्षं)
A constellation, a star: see कक्ष्या, कच्छ, काञ्चि, &c.
E.
कष to hurt or kill, स Uṇādi affix, fem. टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (इ) काक्षि (कांक्षति)
To desire; it is most frequently used with आङ् prefixed, in the same sense.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Frowning, looking scornfully or in displeasure.
m. (-क्षः)
A glance, a wink or leer.
n. (-क्षं)
A frown, a look of displeasure.
E.
का for कु diminutive, or depreciative, and अक्षि the eye.
f. (-क्षी)
1 A sort of trefoil, (Cytisus cajan.)
2 A perfume, a fragrant kind of earth.
E.
कक्ष a creeping plant, अण् and ङीप् affs.

f. (-हा)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
E.
कक्ष an enclosure, and रुह what grows.

m. (-यः)
A dog.
E.
कक्ष an inner room, शाय who sleeps.

n. (-रं)
The inner or private apartment.
E.
कक्ष and अन्तर interior.

m. (-टः)
A cloth passed between the legs to cover the privities.
E.
कक्षा a girdle, and पट a cloth.

m. (-वान्)
The name of a saint.
E.
कक्षा a reply, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A doorkeeper.
2 A guard of the queen's apartments.
3 Keeper of a royal garden.
4 A painter.
5 A poet.
6 A debauchee.
7 Eagerness of feeling, strength of sentiment.
E.
कक्षा an enclosure, and अबेक्ष to see, वुन् aff.

f. (-त्था)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)

n. (-क्ष्यं)
The cup or receptacle of a balance.
f. (-क्ष्या)
1 The girth of an elephant, of rope or leather.
2 A woman's girdle or zone.
3 The enclosure of an edifice; that is, either the wall, &c. so enclosing, or the court or chamber constituting the enclosure.
4 The inner apartment of a palace.
5

Similarity.
6

Effort, exertion.
7 An upper garment.
8 A shrub, yielding the black and red berry, that serves as a jeweller's weight; the Ratti or Gunja, (Abrus precatorius.)
E.
कक्ष the flank, &c. यत् affix; see कक्ष.

f. (-ङ्गुः)
A kind of panick, (P. miliaceum.)
E.
काक, and कङ्ग another species of the same grass; the Kaṅgu of the crows.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Leea hirta): see काकजङ्घा.

f. (-घ्नी)
A tree, said to be a large kind of Karanja, (Galedupa arborea.)
E.
काक, and घ्नी what kills.

f. (-ञ्चा)
The shrub which yields the red and black berry, used in India as a jeweller's weight, (Abrus precatorius): see गुञ्जा.
E.
काक, and चिञ्चा extremity; the point being as black as a crow; also काकचिञ्चि and काकचिञ्ची.

f. (-ञ्ची)
See the preceding.

f. (-ञ्ची)
See काकचिञ्चा.

m. (-दः)
1 A wagtail.
2 Side locks of the head of hair.
E.
काक a crow, and छद plumage.

m. (-र्द्दिः)
1 A wagtail.
2 What is ejected by a crow.
E.
काक and छर्द्दि vomiting.

f. (-ङ्घा)
A plant, (Leea hirta, Rox. Catalogue; elsewhere described as Leea aequata.)
E.
काक, and जङ्गा a thigh; compared to a crow's leg.

f. (-म्बुः)
A plant, commonly Bhuinjamb, (Ardisia solanacea): see भूमिजम्बु; also काकजम्बू.

n. (-णं)
A leprosy with black and red spots, considered incurable.
E.
काक the Gunja berry, deriv. irr. also with कन्, affix काकणक.

f. (-का)
The Abrus precatorius: see काकचिञ्चा.

f. (-ता)
The state or nature of a crow.
E.
काक, and तल् affix; also काकत्वं.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Accidental, unexpected, opportune.
E.
काक, and ताली the fruit of the palm: it alludes to a story of the fruit of the palm falling in the way of a crow.

ind.
Suddenly, opportunely.
E.
काकतालीय, and वत् like.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
Contemptible, vile.
E.
काक, तालु palate, कन् affix of similitude, and इनि aff.

f. (-क्ता)
The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.

m. (-कः)
A kind of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.)
E.
काक, and तिन्दुक ebony.

m. (-ण्डः)
A dark sort of Agallochum: see कालागुरु.
f. (-ण्डी)
1 The Gunja plant.
2 A sort of brass.
3 A tree, commonly Kuwa dorī.
E.
काक, and तुण्ड face; of the colour of a crow.

f. (-का)
The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.

m. (-जः)
Submarine fire, a personage in Hindu mythology: see और्व्व.
E.
काक, and ध्वज a banner, whose symbol is a crow.

f. (-शा)
A plant, commonly Vakapushpa: see वकपुष्प.

f. (-सा)
A plant: see काकजङ्गा; also काकनासिका.

f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Leea hirta.)
2 Red Tëori.
E.
काक a crow, and नासिका a nose; the root being fancifully compared to the beak of the bird; also काकनासा and काकनासिकी.

f. (-न्दी)
Emblick myrobalan.

m. (-क्षः)
The side locks of the head of hair; three or five on each side left when the head is first shaved, and which may be allowed to remain, especially in persons of the military cast.
E.
काक and पक्ष a feather, a wing, a crow's wing; the word is also used as an epithet of a warrior, a name of RĀMA, &c.

m. (-लुः)
A kind of ebony: see काकतिन्दुक; also with कन् added काकपीलुकः.

m. (-च्छः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
काक, and पुच्छ a tail; crow-tailed.

m. (-ष्टः)
The Koil or Kokil, as before.
E.
काक, and पुष्ट nourished; this bird, like the English cuckoo, being said to leave its eggs in the nests of other birds, as in that of the crow, &c.

m. (-लः)
The Nimb tree.
E.
काक, and फल fruit.

f. (-न्ध्या)
A woman that bears only one child.

m. (-रुः)
An owl. काक, and भीरु fearful; afraid of the crows.

m. (-द्गुः)
A water hen, a gallinule.
E.
काक, and मद्गु another kind of bird, a Shag; resembling a crow in colour.

m. (-र्द्दः)
The colocynth or bitter apple.
E.
काक, and मर्द्दक destroying; the fruit of which destroys crows; also काकमर्द्दक.

f. (-का)
A plant: see the next word.

f. (-ची)
An esculent vegetable, commonly Gūrkamai, (Solanum Indicum.)
E.
काक, मच to respect, &c. अण् and ङीष् affixes; also with कन् and टाप् added, काकमाचिका.

f. (-द्गा)
A plant, commonly Mugani, according to some, a wild kind of bean.
E.
काक and मुद्ग Moong.

m. (-वः)
Barren corn, the ear of which has no grain.
E.
काक and यव barley.

Naked.
2

Timid, fearful.
2 Poor, indigent.
m. (-कः)
1 Fraud, deceit.
2 An owl.
3 A henpecked husband.

f. (-हा)
A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tesseloides, &c.) see वन्दा.
E.
काक and रुह what mounts; on which crows rest.

n. (-लं)
A jewel worn upon the neck.
f. (-लिः or -ली)
A low and sweet tone, the song of a bird, &c.
E.
का instead of कु diminutive, कल to sound, इन् or ङीप् aff.

m. (-लः)
A raven.
E.
काक, and अल to be able, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
An ornament of the neck.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-क्षा)
A grape with a very small stone.

m. (-वः)
The Kokila.
E.
काकली a sweet tone, and रव sound.

m. (-ब्दः)
The cawing of a crow.
E.
काक, and शब्द sound.

m. (-र्षः)
A tree, commonly Vakapushpa: (Æschynomene grandiflora.)
E.
काक, and शीर्ष a head.

f. (-स्त्री)
See the preceding.

f. (-ङ्गा)
A plant, (Leea aequata.)
E.
काक, and अङ्ग form, body, टाप् affix; or with ङीष् affix, काकाङ्गी.

f. (-ङ्गी)
See the preceding.

f. (-ञ्ची)
1 A plant, (Leea aequata.)
2 An esculent vegetable, (Solanum Indicum.)
E.
काक, अञ्च to go, अच् and ङीप् affs.

f. (-नी)
The Gunja plant: see काकचिञ्चा.
E.
काक, अदन food, ङीप् fem. aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Scattering water.
E.
क water, क, to scatter; with आङ् prefixed, and अण् aff.

m. (-रिः)
An own.
E.
काक, and अरि a foe; whose enemy is the crow.

f. (-णी)
1 A cubit, the fourth part of a Daṇḍa or short pole.
2 The quarter of a Paṇa, a weight, or a tale of shells equal to twenty

Cowries.
3

A quarter of a Māṣa, a weight of silver or gold.
4 A Ratti or small seed used as a weight.
5 A Cowri or shell used as a coin.
E.
कक to be unsteady, ल्युट् and ङीप् affixes; deriv. irr; also the dental न being substituted, काकिनी.

f. (-नी)
See the preceding.

m. (-लः)
The central jewel in a necklace, &c. see काकल.

f. (-कुः)
1 Change of voice in fear, grief, &c.
2 Muttering, murmuring.
3 The tongue.
E.
कक to deride, उण् affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-दः)
The palate.
E.
ककुद् the head, and अण् aff.

m. (-क्षुः)
A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
काक, and इक्षु sugar cane.

m. (-न्दुः)
A species of ebony, (Diospyros melanoxylon.)

m. (-कः)
A kind of fish, commonly Caouchi; also काकोचि. (Cyprinus cachius, HAM.)

m. (-रः)
Opposite leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia.)

f. (-का)
See the preceding.
E.
काक, and उडुम्बर glomerous fig, कन् affix, and the feminine termination; also काकोदुम्बरिका.

m. (-रः)
A snake.
E.
काक going ill or tortuously, (derived from का for कु, and अक to go,) and उदर the belly.

f. (-का)
The natural enmity of the owl and crow.
E.
काक a crow, उलूक an owl, वुन् affix, implying enmity in this and similar compounds.

m. (-वः)
A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.
E.
का for कु diminutive, and क्षीव to be intoxicated: see अक्षीव; also with कन् added काक्षीवक.
